2610.11430.title: BioBigBird: A Sparse Attention Model for Long-Range Dependency Processing in Biomedical Text
2610.11430.paper_summary: While domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs) have encoded vast biomedical knowledge, their limited context windows often hinder a deep understanding of nuanced relationships within and across texts. To address this limitation, we introduce BioBigBird, a bidirectional language model pre-trained on extensive biomedical literature and clinical data, specifically designed to handle long-range dependencies. BioBigBird leverages a sparse attention mechanism to process sequences up to 4096 tokens, and its training incorporates a multi-stage process to mitigate noise from the large-scale pre-training corpus. We further enhance its performance by employing a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly optimizes for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction. Comprehensive evaluations on the BLURB benchmark reveal that our MTL-enhanced BioBigBird achieves highly competitive results against state-of-the-art models. Our work contributes an effective methodology for developing powerful, long-context language models for specialized domains, demonstrating the value of extended sequence processing for complex text analysis. Our models are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird.
2610.11430.paper_summary_zh: 雖然特定領域的大型語言模型（LLMs）已編碼了大量的生物醫學知識，但其有限的上下文窗口常常妨礙對文本內部及跨文本之間微妙關係的深入理解。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了BioBigBird，一種雙向語言模型，經過在廣泛的生物醫學文獻和臨床數據上進行預訓練，專門設計用於處理長距離依賴。BioBigBird利用稀疏注意力機制來處理長達4096個標記的序列，其訓練過程包含多階段的過程，以減少來自大規模預訓練語料庫的噪音。我們進一步通過採用多任務學習（MTL）框架來提升其性能，該框架共同優化命名實體識別和關係提取。在BLURB基準上的全面評估顯示，我們的MTL增強版BioBigBird在與最先進模型的比較中達到了高度競爭的結果。我們的工作為開發強大的長上下文語言模型提供了一種有效的方法論，並展示了擴展序列處理在複雜文本分析中的價值。我們的模型可在 https://huggingface.co/collections/bisectgroup/biobigbird 上公開獲取。
